_README: Tile-usage presets: named subsets of furniture_catalog.json that say 'these are the tiles an LLM should use when furnishing/parsing the tilemap'. Created/edited in catalog_web.py and consumed by tile_presets.py (--menu prints the LLM-facing tile menu). 'active' names the default preset the LLM uses. Each preset: {description, tiles:[catalog names], notes:{name: hint}}.

general-library.description: Library furnishing palette: reading rooms, book stacks, study/computing desks, staff areas. Used to furnish Fisher Fine Arts Library (and reusable for Van Pelt-style interiors).

notes.rug_red: reading-room / staff centerpiece rug; place a table on it with armchairs around (the franuka idiom)
notes.rug_blue: alternate centerpiece rug (Van Pelt used blue)
notes.dining_table: main reading-room table; 2x3, seat armchairs on its long sides
notes.bookshelf_wood_books: colorful-book shelf for reading rooms / core reading
notes.bookshelf_tan: tan stacks for the rare-books library (visually distinct from the reading-room shelves)
notes.cabinet_display: glass display cabinet for rare books / gallery
notes.student_desk_quill: study/computing desk with quill (computers not modeled yet)
notes.fireplace: lit hearth for reading rooms + staff office; 2x3, set against a wall with armchairs/plant beside it
